publication.body:
Closes #1044

Native first preparation now accepts verified, completed issue-edit history when no local lifecycle index exists. Exact intent/receipt verification remains required; pending, damaged, mismatched and unsupported effects still block, and retained history is preserved.

Validation: 27 focused semantic transaction tests passed, including first-preparation and immutable-history checks plus ten negative cases. Formatting and all-target clippy passed. Independent review found no actionable findings. The isolated candidate successfully prepared and bound #1017; retained validate/doctor results passed. No AWS calls or shared binary replacement.
